name: OpEra
long_description: OpEra Technologies is the AI decision engine for factories, warehouses and fleets. Companies with physical operations make thousands of decisions every day, and we help their teams make the best one at every step from production to delivery: (1) Planning: how much to make, buy and stock. (2) Scheduling: what runs when, and who works on what. (3) Allocation: which warehouse or store gets each order. (4) Routing: boat, plane or truck, and which route each one takes. Founded out of MIT's Operations Research Center.

launches.body:
**TL;DR: OpEra helps operations teams make the best decision at every step of the supply chain: what to produce, what to stock, which orders go on which truck, who works which shift. We build custom AI decision engines that re-plan when reality changes: a sick employee, a broken machine, a new regulation.**

**🎬 Launch Video**: <https://youtu.be/3wfSc84J8b4>

Hi, we're Hindy and Bernardo. We met at MIT's Operations Research Center, where we worked on delivery routing for a major retailer. On their data, **our model cut transportation costs by 38%**. More projects followed, and **we turned down offers from Palantir, Mercor and Stack AI to build OpEra.**

**🏭 The problem**

Every day, companies decide what to produce, how much stock to hold, which orders go on which trucks and who works which shift. Most still **plan in spreadsheets, or in software built for the average factory or warehouse. But no two operations are the same.** Generic rules produce workable plans, not the best ones, and **the gap is real money and real waste**. And when a machine breaks, a truck runs late or an order changes, someone rebuilds the plan by hand, and more is lost.

**🧠 What OpEra does**

**OpEra connects to your existing systems (WMS, ERPs, Excel) and builds an optimization model of your operation: equipment, people, capacity and rules.** From that model it produces your **production schedules**, **warehouse plans** and **delivery routes**. When something changes, your planner describes it in plain language, in the interface or to the OpEra agent, and the plan is recomputed around the new constraints.

📊 **Results on real operational data**

• **38% lower delivery cost and 10% more on-time deliveries** for a major retailer

• **10.4% higher premium over market on the same volume** for a global sugar producer

• **54% fewer unfulfilled orders** for a services marketplace

**🏅 Why us**

We're **operations researchers from MIT**. Bernardo built **optimization models at Sanofi and did AI research at BMW**. Hindy did **machine learning research on nuclear fusion at MIT**, on a Los Alamos-sponsored project, and built the **hallucination-detection system used by thousands of consultants at McKinsey.**

**🤝 Our ask**

If your team plans production, a warehouse or deliveries in spreadsheets or in pre-AI software (WMS, ERPs, etc.), we'd love to **deploy OpEra at one of your sites**. And if you know a **COO, VP of Supply Chain, plant manager or head of logistics** with this problem, we'd appreciate an intro.
